description: Move a written note by a named interval. The letter moves with the interval number, then the accidental is chosen to hit the semitones. A perfect third is rejected, and so is a quality that would need more than a double accidental. Up and down are the two directions. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: GET https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/music-transpose
